contentEn:
A Surrey kitchen renovation with custom cabinets typically costs $35,000-$38,000 in Metro Vancouver, with timelines of 4-5 weeks. This guide covers real costs, what drives them, and how to plan your project in 2026.

What Drives Kitchen Renovation Cost in Surrey

Cabinetry is the largest single expense in any Surrey kitchen renovation, accounting for 30-40% of total budget. Custom wood-grain cabinets with soft-close hinges and finger-pull hardware run $18,000-$22,000 for an average-sized kitchen. Pre-built or semi-custom options reduce cost but limit sizing flexibility.

2026 Surrey Kitchen Cost Breakdown

Material and labour costs in Surrey are competitive compared to Vancouver, but permits and bylaw compliance add overhead. A mid-range Surrey kitchen renovation with custom cabinets, quartz countertops, and quality fixtures typically breaks down as:

  • Custom cabinets and hardware: $18,000-$22,000
  • Quartz countertops (2cm engineered): $3,500-$5,500
  • Backsplash (quartz or tile): $1,500-$3,000
  • Electrical updates and lighting: $1,500-$2,500
  • Plumbing adjustments: $800-$1,500
  • Labour and installation: $6,000-$9,000
  • Permits and inspections (Surrey): $800-$1,200

How Long Does a Surrey Kitchen Renovation Take?

A mid-range Surrey kitchen renovation with custom cabinets takes 4-5 weeks from demolition to final walkthrough. The longest phase is cabinet fabrication (2-3 weeks), while demo, electrical, and plumbing can run in parallel during that wait. Surrey bylaw inspections are typically required for any electrical or plumbing work.

Surrey Kitchen Trends 2026

Surrey homeowners choosing modern aesthetics in 2026 are trending toward wood-grain and white contrasting cabinet combinations, silver fixtures, and quartz surfaces. Recessed LED lighting and soft-close hardware are now standard expectations rather than upgrades. A well-designed Surrey kitchen renovation adds both resale value and daily quality of life.

Reno Stars has completed kitchen renovations in Surrey, Richmond, Vancouver, and across the Lower Mainland. Contact us for a free estimate.

素里定制櫃台廚房翻新費用通常在$35,000-$38,000之間，施工時間為4-5週。本指南涵蓋真實費用、影響因素及2026年如何規劃您的項目。

什麼影響素里廚房翻新費用

櫃台是素里廚房翻新中最大的單項開支，佔總預算的30-40%。帶緩閉鉸鏈和指拉式硬件的定制木紋櫃台造價$18,000-$22,000，適用於中等面積廚房。預製或半定制選項可降低成本，但尺寸調整靈活性有限。

2026年素里廚房費用明細

與溫哥華相比，素里的材料和人工費用具有競爭力，但許可和附例合規需增加開支。中檔素里廚房翻新（含定制櫃台、石英石台面和優質五金）的典型費用明細如下：

  • 定制櫃台及五金：$18,000-$22,000
  • 石英石台面（2厘米工程石）：$3,500-$5,500
  • 防濺板（石英或瓷磚）：$1,500-$3,000
  • 電氣更新及照明：$1,500-$2,500
  • 管道調整：$800-$1,500
  • 人工及安裝：$6,000-$9,000
  • 許可證及檢查（素里）：$800-$1,200

素里廚房翻新需要多長時間？

中等檔次定制櫃台素里廚房翻新從拆遷到最終驗收需要4-5週。最長的階段是櫃台製作（2-3週），而拆遷、電氣和管道工作可在該等待期間並行進行。素里附例通常要求任何電氣或管道工程進行檢查。

2026年素里廚房趨勢

2026年選擇現代風格的素里業主趨向於木紋和白色對比櫃台組合、銀色五金和石英石表面。嵌入式LED照明和緩閉硬件現已成為標準配置而非升級選擇。設計良好的素里廚房翻新可同時增加轉售價值和日常生活品質。

聚星裝修已在素里、列治文、溫哥華及低陸地區完成廚房翻新工程。聯繫我們獲取免費報價。
